newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu met a delegation of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) led by Poul Thomsen, the Fund's negotiator with Romania, who arrived in Bucharest on Wednesday.
* Constantinescu is meeting with Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu and his government's four state ministers. Prime Minister-designate Victor Ciorbea and presidential advisor Zoe Petre are attending.
* Ciorbea said a schedule for presenting the new cabinet list and the governing programme will be respected with the cabinet members expected to appear before parliament on Monday.

He said the ruling Democratic Convention's (CDR) leadership would meet in the afternoon to finalise the cabinet list and discuss the text of a governing accord due to be signed on Friday by the CDR and its coalition partners, the Social Democratic Union (USD) and the Hungarian Democratic UNion (UDMR).

* The USD would get one portfolio less than originally agreed, its leaders said on Thursday. They said Victor Babiuc would become the new defence minister while Adrian Severin will have the foreign affairs portfolio.
Traian Basescu was designated for the transport ministry, Ion Oltean for the environment portfolio and Radu Berceanu for the newly formed Information and Public Relations Ministry.
No decision was taken yet on the labour and social protection ministry, where two persons had been designated -- Smaranda Dobrescu and Alexandru Athanasiu, they said.

* The Chamber of Deputies completed debate on the composition of 14 standing commissions. The National Peasant Party (PNT-CD) and the Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) would each appoint chairmen for four of the commissions, with the USD holding two such positions.
The National Liberal Party (PNL), the UDMR, the Gretaer Romania Party (PRM) and the National Unity Party (PUNR) would each name chairmen for the remaining four commissions.

* The Senate set up its 14 standing commissions, assigning their leadership to the PDSR (for four commissions), the PNT-CD (three), USD (two), PNL (2) and one for each PUNR, UDMR, PRM. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
